resources.string: Lets a Mac you allow in Bridgey tap, swipe, go Back or Home and type on this phone while it sees your screen. When nobody is here to approve video, it can send screenshots to a Mac you allow without asking. Bridgey never reads text or buttons from the screen and never uses your clipboard. You can stop it on the phone at any time.
